raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Starting with the most recent batches, the source sends reversals as separate status='REVERSAL' rows (24 rows, linked by orig_txn_id) instead of changing the original's status to REVERSED. The originals stay status='POSTED', so silver keeps them and gold totals come out higher than settlement for recent days. The fix assumes each REVERSAL fully reverses its original; if partial reversals exist, the source team should confirm.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.65, "pre_sql": ["CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reversed_txn_ids AS SELECT DISTINCT CAST(orig_txn_id AS BIGINT) AS orig_txn_id FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'REVERSAL' AND orig_txn_id IS NOT NULL"], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions r WHERE status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reversed_txn_ids v WHERE v.orig_txn_id = CAST(r.txn_id AS BIGINT))"}}
